title: Teenager Hannah Klugman Wins Her Biggest Tennis Title Yet
summary:
British teenager Hannah Klugman has won the biggest tennis title of her life so far. The 17-year-old beat French player Elsa Jacquemot 6-2 6-4 in the final of the Lexus Wrexham Open. It was a W100 title, and Klugman did not lose a set all week.

Klugman is the second British player in a row to win the Wrexham title, after Mimi Xu won last year. She is also the youngest British player to win a singles trophy at W100 level or higher.

Jacquemot is ranked world number 157. Klugman missed her first two chances to break serve, but she kept going and soon took control of the match. Jacquemot fought back to 5-4, but Klugman served out the win at her second chance.

Afterwards, Klugman said, "I was shaking afterwards, but just so, so happy and proud of myself again." There was more British success in doubles, too: Freya Christie and Eden Silva beat Hiroko Kuwata and Ankita Raina 6-2 6-3.
why_it_matters: It shows that keeping going after missed chances can help you reach a goal you care about.
